gallery.title: ICAI Peer Review Board Certification & Quality Milestone

photos.caption: Official presentation of the ICAI Peer Review Board compliance certificate (PRC-014289).
Partners and assurance audit leads reviewing quality control documentation frameworks.
Audit team briefing on Standard on Quality Control (SQC 1) adherence.

gallery.caption: Recognition of rigorous quality control frameworks, audit documentation, and full adherence to ICAI standards.
gallery.story:
In April 2026, M/s NRSR & Co achieved a significant regulatory milestone with the successful completion of the Peer Review process by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) Peer Review Board, holding Certificate No. PRC-014289. In addition, the firm maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification for its Quality Management System.

This peer review validation reflects our steadfast commitment to SQC 1 (Standard on Quality Control), ethical standards, client confidentiality, and uncompromising audit integrity across our offices in Manipal and Bengaluru. The review encompassed sample engagements across statutory audits, corporate valuations, and indirect tax advisory.

gallery.title: Annual Firm Strategy & Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Seminar

photos.caption: Keynote presentation on Union Budget tax amendments and corporate compliance.
Breakout technical discussion on automated audit data analytics.
Team collaborative workshop on IBBI Registered Valuation methodologies.

gallery.caption: Intensive multi-day CPD technical workshop analyzing Union Budget amendments, Ind AS updates, and AI audit tools.
gallery.story:
The NRSR & Co Annual Strategy & CPD Seminar brought together our entire audit, tax, and consulting teams from Manipal and Bengaluru. The 2-day conference focused on deep-dive analyses of the Union Budget 2026 tax reforms, emerging Transfer Pricing scrutiny triggers, and hands-on training in automated Power BI financial modeling.

Led by Managing Partner CA Shrinidhi Rao and Partner CA Swetha SV, the sessions emphasized continuous learning and technical mastery as the cornerstone of exceptional client service.
